variants.label: mechanical squeeze of empty rows/columns
variants.architecture: Whole-program squeeze via src/littleman/alexey_squeeze.py (full): every row made only of ' ' and '|', and every column made only of ' ' and '-', is deleted. No room re-laid, no pipe re-routed. Shortens each room interior and each vertical pipe it crosses by one cell; the walk is identical apart from being shorter, which is why ticks fall too.
variants.verdict: TEAM BEST for tcp: 5,981,626 -> 5,655,750 (1.06x). Most of the gain on the large programs is ticks, not area -- the surviving pipes got shorter.

variants.label: offset-addressed window, tag-through-ring (v2 architecture)
variants.architecture: splitter (seq->pump top, val parked at insert), pump writes only to the ring, drain emits tags (-v data, -2000 loss, -3000 marker), forwarder room decodes tags to OUTPUT and refills emitted slots with zeros; per packet: rotate exactly d, discard, insert, lap to marker, drain, realign(+15 relay)

source.generator: src/littleman/alexey_tcp_v2.py + scratch assembly (to be moved in)

localValidation.stress: 45/45 synthetic incl. n=48, full window, instant loss

variants.verdict: WORKS BUT LOSES: ticks dominate. Three full ring laps per packet (rotate+lap, then realign) serialize against ~30 ticks of ring latency (RIN 22 cells + FWD 8-tick loop). To beat 20M at 13.7k ticks the footprint would need <1458 (38x38), unreachable with a 42-row pump. The win requires the tick pass: drop the realign lap (fold the +1 offset into the next rotate), shorten the forwarder loop and the return pipe. Estimated 3-4x ticks available there.

variants.label: recovered no-realignment tag ring
variants.architecture: Ring holds only w1..w15 (15 values, no sentinel); w0 is implicit because it is always empty at packet start. d>=1: rotate d-1, pop stale, push val, relay 15-d (16 ops, no drain). d==0: emit val directly then pop-and-emit while head>0; the forwarder's 0 refill lands exactly where the freed slot belongs, so the invariant self-restores (2 ops for an in-order packet). Splitter sends seq AND 15-seq so both loop counts come from one `-` and one `+` with exp held in B. Forwarder fast path 8 cells.
